source: Original-coordinate205-species12028 first-island-record events; retain225-species candidate scope
unit: One butterfly species x WGSRPD3region; median nearest-prior-record distance across island events in that region
features: native-host share of global catalogue hosts
contemporary-not-native host share of global catalogue hosts
coverage: Only events with existing nonmissing regional host context and unique region mapping; do not replace missing regional host context with zero
method: Within-species Spearman correlation across regions; >=5 regions and both variables varying. Also report>=10-region sensitivity and prior-observation-opportunity subset. Average correlation equally across eligible species, with descriptive species-bootstrap intervals only when>=20 species; no confirmatory p-values.
checks: Reconstructed contemporary host counts must match existing available_hosts. Keep mismatches in audit and do not silently reinterpret source inputs.
limits: Present regional catalogue is not local historical host availability; native-complement is only a non-native candidate. Geography, climate, land use and observer coverage remain potential explanations. Correlation cannot show host-mediated movement or prediction benefit. Species bootstrap does not account for phylogeny or shared regions. Coarse regional associations cannot identify island stepping stones.
